fieldValues.title: srs-rust#973's fix needs a release cut and a pin advance before docs/spec/** shows any diff
fieldValues.summary: PR srs-rust#1019 implements RFC-037 Revision 4's block-opening scalar row form in format_field_row_text, but merging it alone produces no visible change anywhere -- srs's docs/spec/** is pinned to a specific tagged srs-rust release (SRS_RUST_CLI_TAG in srs/.github/workflows/release-drift.yml) and is only re-rendered when that pin advances.
fieldValues.rationale: RFC-037 Revision 4's own text (srs#714) already states this: 'the pinned CLI does not yet implement it -- srs-rust#973... Revision 4 produces no export diff of its own, for the same reason.' The next unit that wants the 21 measured broken sites (Problem 7's evidence, including docs/spec/srs-spec.md:30) to actually render correctly needs to: (1) confirm srs-rust#1019 merged, (2) cut a new srs-rust release, (3) advance SRS_RUST_CLI_TAG in srs/.github/workflows/release-drift.yml and re-render docs/spec/** in the same PR, per the two-step choreography srs-rust#782 already established for the analogous empty-value-row fix. Do not assume merging srs-rust#1019 alone closes srs#714 or the row-form defect end to end.
